verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a live OpenAPI document at https://amplitude.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, containing an "openapi" key), so a machine-readable spec can be downloaded directly. Amplitude also documents several REST APIs (HTTP V2, Export, Dashboard REST, Taxonomy, Cohorts) that such a spec would describe. Missing for 10: first-party docs that describe or link the spec, evidence of which APIs it covers and whether it is complete, and independent corroboration of its quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://amplitude.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
